newsitem.title: UK: BZW hires two for acquisitions finance team.
newsitem.headline: BZW hires two for acquisitions finance team.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of British banking giant Barclays, said on Tuesday it had made two new appointments to its acquisition finance group, within its structured finance division.
Jonathan Rowland will join the group from HSBC Investment Bank and Jonathan Hosgood will move to BZW from Hambros, BZW said in a statement.

It said the group had been set up early in 1996 and was led by Chris Coles. Coles said the group intended to extend its reach into the "larger leveraged buyout market for deals worth over 100 million stg".
BZW also said it had recently hired Andrew Golding as a director of loan syndications and distributions from HSBC Investment Bank.
